queries.name: o2c_case_sequences
queries.purpose: Computes real per-stage duration (ORDER_QUEUE/FULFILLMENT_DWELL/CARRIER_TRANSIT/BILLING_SETTLEMENT, from ORDER/SHIPMENT/INVOICE/PAYMENT timestamps) for every case, then z-scores each duration against its OWN stage's mean/stdev (avg()/stDevP(), both built into Cypher -- same z-score check anomaly_engine.py does, just computed here directly instead of imported). Cases with ANY stage z-score >= $zscore_threshold count as delayed; their full event_type sequence, sorted by event_time, is returned. Feeds PrefixSpan.
queries.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (o:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:ORDER {process: $process_type})
  WHERE o.order_date IS NOT NULL AND o.allocated_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN o.case_id AS case_id, 'ORDER_QUEUE' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(o.order_date), datetime(o.allocated_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.pick_started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS case_id, 'FULFILLMENT_DWELL' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.pick_started_at), datetime(s.shipped_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (s:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:SHIPMENT {process: $process_type})
  WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN s.case_id AS case_id, 'CARRIER_TRANSIT' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(s.shipped_at), datetime(s.delivered_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds

  UNION ALL

  MATCH (inv:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:INVOICE {process: $process_type})
  MATCH (pay:Entity:BUSINESS_OBJECT:PAYMENT {case_id: inv.case_id})
  WHERE inv.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND pay.cleared_at IS NOT NULL
  RETURN inv.case_id AS case_id, 'BILLING_SETTLEMENT' AS stage,
         toFloat(duration.inSeconds(datetime(inv.posted_at), datetime(pay.cleared_at)).seconds) AS dwell_seconds
}
WITH stage, collect({case_id: case_id, dwell: dwell_seconds}) AS rows,
     avg(dwell_seconds) AS stage_mean, stDevP(dwell_seconds) AS stage_std
UNWIND rows AS r
WITH r.case_id AS case_id, r.dwell AS dwell, stage_mean, stage_std
WHERE stage_std > 0 AND (dwell - stage_mean) / stage_std >= $zscore_threshold
WITH collect(DISTINCT case_id) AS delayed_case_ids
MATCH (ev:EVENT {process: $process_type})
WHERE ev.case_id IN delayed_case_ids
WITH ev ORDER BY ev.case_id, ev.event_time ASC
WITH ev.case_id AS case_id, collect(ev.event_type) AS sequence
RETURN case_id, sequence
